source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The first port declares only custom release-level for bouncer-locations scope substitution, while the unchanged scope map is keyed by project. This follow-up replaces that input with from-parameters project: project; the accepted declaration keeps that shape. This proves the local declaration correction, not its role in the separate reported release-alias dict-versus-string failure. Upstream resolver behavior and a successful graph/release task were not verified.
title: The bouncer locations follow-up exposes its project-keyed scope input
